title: LogicalDataComponent
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — logical data entity or grouping independent of physical storage technology. Complementary definition layer to PhysicalDataComponent: both define the same identity (data storage) at different abstraction levels (logical = strategic/design, physical = infrastructure/implementation). Extends Structure with TOGAF Data Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Logical Data Component (Content Metamodel, Data Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Data Architecture, Content Framework).

dataScope.description: Logical data scope. MASTER = authoritative enterprise entities. REFERENCE = shared lookup/code data. TRANSACTIONAL = operational event data. ANALYTICAL = derived/aggregated data. TOGAF mapping: Logical Data Component data classification.

ownershipModel.description: Data ownership model. TOGAF mapping: Data governance ownership pattern.
